title: Registration opens for Paris Packaging Week
summary: Registration is now open for the next edition of Paris Packaging Week, taking place on February 3-4, 2027. The organizers report a record nearly 950 exhibitors showcasing packaging solutions for the beauty, aerosols, premium drinks, luxury and design sectors.
